item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Danish fish cakes with roasted potatoes, topped with steamed broccoli. Served with remoulade, cucumber salad and lemon on the side. (1+2+3+10+11)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Turkish tantuni with chicken, vegetables and rice. Served with lime, red onion salad with sumac and parsley, lemon yoghurt and pickled mild peppers on the side. Also available gluten free. (1+6+11+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Turkish tantuni with tofu, vegetables and rice. Served with lime, red onion salad with sumac and parsley, lemon yoghurt and pickled mild peppers on the side. Also available gluten free. (1+6+7+11+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Chicken curry the way we know and love it, served with fluffy rice, mango chutney and peanuts. (4+6+9+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Tofu curry, served with fluffy rice, mango chutney and peanuts. (4+6+7+9+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chicken breast marinated in thyme and rosemary, served with roasted potatoes and Caesar salad. (2+3+6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Halloumi marinated in thyme and rosemary, served with roasted potatoes and Caesar salad. (2+3+6+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Crispy fried chicken with roasted new potatoes and a spiced brown sauce, topped with green beans tossed in parsley and browned butter. Served with an apple, onion and thyme compote and a fresh green salad with sherry vinaigrette on the side. (1+6+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Roasted portobello mushrooms with roasted new potatoes and a spiced brown sauce, topped with green beans tossed in parsley and browned butter. Served with an apple, onion and thyme compote and a fresh green salad with sherry vinaigrette on the side. (1+6+11+13+15)
